# @sharadox/es-lint-configuration-web-library

> Shared ESLint flat configs, one entry per project kind; Prettier-compatible.

- `@sharadox/es-lint-configuration-web-library/node` → nodeConfiguration({ ignores? }): @eslint/js + typescript-eslint recommended + eslint-config-prettier; ignores documentation/, distribution/, coverage/.
- `…/react-library` → reactLibraryConfiguration({ ignores? }): node config + eslint-plugin-react-hooks recommended.
- `…/next-js-application` → nextJsApplicationConfiguration({ ignores? }): eslint-config-next core-web-vitals + typescript + prettier; also ignores .next/, test-results/, playwright-report/, next-env.d.ts. Requires eslint-config-next.
- Use: `export default nodeConfiguration();` in eslint.config.mjs; extend with `[...nodeConfiguration(), { rules: {...} }]`.
- Licence: Sharadox Open Source Licence 0.1.0
